name: projects/k8s-investigation-agent/locations/us-east1/semanticGovernancePolicies/k8s-agent-least-privilege-sgp
description: Enforces strict read-only tool boundaries on the agent's SPIFFE identity; allows list_pods, get_pod_logs, get_pod_events, get_deployment_history, get_nodes_info, and investigate_kubernetes_logs while explicitly denying restart_deployment and get_secret.

rules.naturalLanguageConstraint: The agent is strictly an incident investigation assistant with read-only cluster access. Only allow invocations of read-only diagnostic tools: list_pods, get_pod_logs, get_pod_events, get_deployment_history, get_nodes_info, and investigate_kubernetes_logs. Explicitly and strictly DENY any mutating tools (such as restart_deployment, deployment patches, or scaling operations). Explicitly and strictly DENY any credential retrieval or secret inspection tools (such as get_secret or accessing Kubernetes Secret resources). If the agent attempts to invoke restart_deployment or get_secret, the Agent Gateway must immediately block the tool call and return the denial message.

agentResponseCustomization.denialMessage: Agent Gateway Policy Violation: Tool execution was blocked by the Agent Gateway Least-Privilege Semantic Governance Policy. The agent's SPIFFE identity (spiffe://agents.global.org-310633432312.system.id.goog/resources/aiplatform/projects/1098749337818/locations/us-east1/reasoningEngines/2253300647057162240) is restricted to read-only diagnostics and is explicitly denied from executing mutations (restart_deployment) and reading secrets (get_secret).
